train.origin: original model-written synthetic prose in this repository

holdout.origin: original model-written synthetic prose in this repository

predeclared_config.compression: eligible non-parameter-backed finite CPU float32 tensors with at least256elements, symmetric maxabs per last dimension; backward saved-tensor approximation only
predeclared_config.evaluation: initial and final heldout NLL only; no intermediate holdout selection
predeclared_config.budget: matched training tokens/steps; wall-clock measured, not matched; time limit aborts incomplete runs

split_protocol: Separate complete source files; take first8nonoverlapping65token blocks from each. No padding/special tokens, no cross-file joins.64inputs predict positions1..64. Unused suffixes excluded.
limitations: Tiny synthetic prose diagnostic, not a natural language benchmark or general model-quality claim.
The original train prose was used previously for frozen forward capture; it was not held out in that earlier experiment.
Equal token/step budgets only. Timing and process peaks remain machine-specific observations.
Training with backward saved-tensor compression is independent activation-memory research, not an AttnRes implementation.
